outgoing.name: Cretaceous
outgoing.excerpt: Hypsilophodon ( IPA: /ˌhɪpsɪˈlɔfodɔn/; meaning 'high-crested tooth') is an ornithopod dinosaur genus from the Early Cretaceous Period of Europe.

outgoing.name: England
outgoing.excerpt: Abundant fossil remains found in England indicate that Hypsilophodon reached about 2 meters (6.5 feet) in length.

outgoing.name: Europe
outgoing.excerpt: Hypsilophodon ( IPA: /ˌhɪpsɪˈlɔfodɔn/; meaning 'high-crested tooth') is an ornithopod dinosaur genus from the Early Cretaceous Period of Europe.

outgoing.name: Fossil
outgoing.excerpt: Abundant fossil remains found in England indicate that Hypsilophodon reached about 2 meters (6.5 feet) in length.

outgoing.name: Jurassic
outgoing.excerpt: The group Hypsilophodontia remained remarkably static from the late Jurassic to the end of the Cretaceous.

outgoing.name: Paleontology
outgoing.excerpt: The first remains of Hypsilophodon were recovered in the early days of paleontology in 1849.

outgoing.name: Portugal
outgoing.excerpt: Other finds have been made in southern England, Portugal and South Dakota, USA.
